fields.description: How dates are shown in forms, lists, reports, prints and the calendar. Dates are always stored as AD. Each user can override this in their own settings (User > Date Display).
fields.label: Default Date Display
Help
fields.options:
• Both: AD with the BS date alongside, e.g. 18-11-2026 (2 Mangsir 2083). Date fields get a BS picker button.
  • BS: dates are shown and typed in Bikram Sambat (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2083-08-02); focusing a date field opens the BS picker.
  • AD: standard Frappe behaviour; no BS anywhere.

Excel/CSV exports get an extra BS column next to each date column unless the display is AD. Reload the page after changing this.
